# Teton Gravity Research Forums

> > Community forums for mountain sports enthusiasts covering skiing, snowboarding, and outdoor adventures, hosted by Teton Gravity Research (TGR).

The TGR Forums serve as a hub for action sports athletes and outdoor enthusiasts to discuss skiing, snowboarding, gear, conditions, trip reports, and general adventure topics. The community includes regional discussions (Cascadia, Colorado, Tahoe) and a marketplace for buying and selling outdoor equipment.

## Key Topics

- Teton Gravity Research (TGR)
- Mountain sports
- Skiing
- Snowboarding
- Avalanche safety
- Trip reports
- Snow conditions
- Gear reviews
- Cascadia Region
- Colorado
- Tahoe
- Community discussion
- Gear marketplace
- Forum navigation

## Main Forums

- [Forums Homepage](https://forums.tetongravity.com): Homepage for TGR outdoor sports forums covering skiing, surfing, climbing
- [Forum Index](https://forums.tetongravity.com/home/forum): Main forum index for TGR ski/snowboard and outdoor sports discussions
- [General Ski / Snowboard Discussion](https://forums.tetongravity.com/home/forum/ski-snowboard/general-ski-snowboard-discussion): Main ski and snowboard discussion forum for mountain sports enthusiasts
- [The Padded Room](https://forums.tetongravity.com/home/forum/chatter-blather-and-archives/the-padded-room): Off-topic discussion area for non-sport related community chat

## Gear & Equipment

- [Gear Swap (List View)](https://forums.tetongravity.com/home/forum/gear-buy-sell/gear-swap-list-view): Marketplace for buying and selling outdoor gear within TGR community
- [Tech Talk](https://forums.tetongravity.com/home/forum/gear-buy-sell/tech-talk): Technical gear discussion forum for equipment and tech topics

## Community Features

- [Calendar](https://forums.tetongravity.com/calendar): Community event calendar and forum statistics for TGR
- [Member List](https://forums.tetongravity.com/memberlist): Searchable directory of all TGR forum members and profiles
- [Who's Online](https://forums.tetongravity.com/online): Current active users and member directory (access restricted)

## Help & Support

- [Help](https://forums.tetongravity.com/help): Forum help guide covering navigation, features, and account management

## Optional

- [TGR Forum Archives](https://forums.tetongravity.com/home/forum/chatter-blather-and-archives/tgr-forum-archives): Archived threads inactive for over a year from TGR forums
- [Privacy Policy](https://forums.tetongravity.com/privacy): Privacy policy for Teton Gravity Research Forums
